scripts.test: cross-env DATABASE_PROVIDER=sqlite DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db node scripts/select-prisma-schema.mjs sqlite && cross-env DATABASE_PROVIDER=sqlite DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db prisma db push && cross-env DATABASE_PROVIDER=sqlite DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db vitest run --pool=forks --poolOptions.forks.singleFork=true
